note: Manufacturer (own plants in India and South Africa, est. 1949, Pune HQ) — role manufacturer, not a trader. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L lines with HS codes and B/L numbers, all in 2022 and all routed through Nhava Sheva to Italy and Australia; no post-2022 export line was visible on the free page, so recency beyond 2022 is unverified. HS note: declared codes 400821/401012/591000 are broadly consistent with the observed cargo (conveyor belt, rubber moulded impact bar), but the customs lines themselves carry 6-digit codes 840021/640100/401000/400000, which look like truncated or mis-keyed variants of 4010/4011/4008 — the actual HS should be reconciled against the shipping bill rather than the declared list. Domestic supply evidence is absent from public sources in this session: no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP award, no contract record found; the site's client testimonials (Tata Steel, JSW, Sesa Goa, FLSmidth) are claims only. Revenue: null — not public, not invented. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role). Verdict basis: real export shipments exist, so the company is not a no-supply case; domestic side remains unconfirmed.
